text.tspan: Not better and worse — a trade between how light the tool is and how much it does for you.
lighter, opens instantly, knows nothing about your code <<-------------------->> heavier, slower to start, understands your code
This course uses VS Code because it sits in the middle: light enough to open for one file,
capable enough to debug a real program — and it is free on every operating system.
You will meet all four in a career. Knowing which one a job needs is part of the skill.
